purpose: Predeclared bounded CPU Transformer language-model comparison; not LLM-scale or universal non-regression certification
selection: Lowest final validation NLL for each policy; ties use declared LR-grid order; test data never tokenized or evaluated during tuning

corpus.name: Tiny Shakespeare, original public-domain Shakespeare text distributed by karpathy/char-rnn
corpus.split: Contiguous byte ranges: train [0,floor(0.8*N)), validation [floor(0.8*N),floor(0.9*N)), test [floor(0.9*N),N); no cross-split context
corpus.tokenization: Raw bytes, fixed vocabulary 0..255, no learned tokenizer, text cleanup, or held-out vocabulary discovery

model.architecture: Causal pre-LayerNorm TransformerEncoderLayer blocks with independently initialized layers, learned positions, final LayerNorm, untied output projection

training.sampling: Uniform independent contiguous training windows with replacement; separate CPU generator seeded seed+1000; identical index stream per paired seed
training.scheduler_clock: One update after each 64-step window; DLRS consumes all 64 ordered unscaled minibatch mean losses; CosineAnnealingLR T_max=6, eta_min=0
training.initialization: Same torch seed per paired trial; embeddings/linear weights normal std0.02, biases zero, independently drawn attention projections
training.trial_order: Rotate policy order by LR-grid index for tuning and by confirmation-seed index for confirmation
training.budget_behavior: No default wall-clock cutoff; fixed384 optimizer updates per trial bound compute. Optional explicit resource interruption is incomplete evidence, never a shortened completed trial.

evaluation.metric: Mean next-byte cross entropy in natural-log units (nats per target byte)
evaluation.coverage: All targets except the first byte of each held-out split, exactly once; consecutive context-length blocks with context reset, including the final partial block
evaluation.mode: eval/no_grad; final model only; validation once after training; held-out test only in confirmation

acceptance.status: PROVISIONAL research comparison criterion, not a production safety margin
acceptance.rule: Require all 15 confirmation trials to complete with finite results and the paired 95% percentile-bootstrap upper bound for mean DLRS-minus-baseline test NLL to be <=0.05 against each tuned baseline
acceptance.interval: Enumerate all 5^5 ordered bootstrap resamples of paired seed differences; pointwise exploratory percentile intervals, not exact frequentist coverage or simultaneous confidence guarantees
acceptance.margin_context: 0.05 nats corresponds to exp(0.05), about 1.0513 times perplexity; chosen before outcomes as a provisional bound, not justified by a downstream user risk budget
acceptance.failures: Retain failed tuning and confirmation trials; failed tuning candidates cannot be selected; any failed/missing confirmation or budget interruption prevents acceptance
acceptance.timing: Record wall times and paired ratios only as exploratory shared-laptop observations
